info.title: Airline Management API - Flights
info.description: OpenAPI definition migrated from the VB.NET WinForms `EditFlightForm.BtnUpdate_Click` handler. Validates flight input, checks flight number uniqueness, and updates the Flight record.

put.description:
Fully replaces the editable fields of an existing flight. Migrated from the legacy `EditFlightForm.BtnUpdate_Click` handler.

Legacy behavior preserved:
- All string inputs are trimmed before validation.
- `flightNumber`, `origin`, and `destination` are required.
- `flightNumber` must be unique unless it is unchanged from the stored value.
- `price` must be a valid decimal greater than 0.
- `availableSeats` must be a valid integer that is not negative.
- All validation errors are collected and returned together.
- `departureDate` uses only the date portion; `departureTime` and `arrivalTime` use only the time-of-day portion.
- The update is applied to all eight editable columns of the flight record.

Assumption: the legacy application has no authentication; the bearer token requirement is added for the modernized API.

parameters.name: flightId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the flight to update. Legacy source: the `selectedFlightId` constructor argument of `EditFlightForm`.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer token. Assumption: not present in the legacy app; added for the modernized API.

requestBody.description: Editable flight fields. Corresponds to the txt/dtp controls read by `BtnUpdate_Click`.

flightNumber.description: Flight number. Trimmed. Must be unique unless unchanged from the stored value. Legacy messages: 'Flight number is required.' / 'Flight number already exists. Please use a unique flight number.'

origin.description: Departure origin. Trimmed. Legacy message: 'Origin is required.'

destination.description: Arrival destination. Trimmed. Legacy message: 'Destination is required.'

departureDate.description: Departure date. Legacy: DateTime from dtpDepartureDate.Value.Date (date part only).

departureTime.description: Departure time of day (HH:mm:ss). Legacy: TimeSpan from dtpDepartureTime.Value.TimeOfDay.

arrivalTime.description: Arrival time of day (HH:mm:ss). Legacy: TimeSpan from dtpArrivalTime.Value.TimeOfDay.

price.description: Ticket price. Legacy: Decimal parsed from txtPrice; must be greater than 0 ('Price must be greater than 0.').

availableSeats.description: Seats available for booking. Legacy: Integer parsed from txtAvailableSeats; cannot be negative ('Available seats cannot be negative.').

200.description: Flight updated successfully. Legacy: 'Flight updated successfully!' message box, then the form closes.

400.description: Validation failed. Legacy: all messages shown in lblError, joined by line breaks.

errors: Flight number already exists. Please use a unique flight number.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid bearer token. Not in legacy code; required for the modernized API.

403.description: Forbidden. The caller is not allowed to update flights. Not in legacy code; required for the modernized API.

404.description: Flight not found. Legacy: LoadFlight shows 'Flight not found.' when no flight matches the id.

500.description: Internal server error. Legacy: lblError set to 'An error occurred: ' plus the exception message when the database update fails.

message.example: An error occurred: Database connection failed.

example.message: An error occurred: Database connection failed.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token for the modernized API. Not present in the legacy application.
